objective: Replace fixed-genesis directional sizing with deterministic compounding from each Pump/Pons family's reconciled realized sleeve equity while preserving the 5% target and every existing safety/capacity/downsize control.

sizing_rule.reservation_cap_formula: min(target, currently_available_sleeve_capital) before strategy-specific execution/capacity downsizing

minimums.pump_current: preserve existing gas/entry-overhead semantics; 5% economic target compounds from realized equity
minimums.pons_current: existing execution/impact/demand caps remain binding after dynamic 5% capital cap
minimums.pons_survivor: scale the existing 5 bps minimum-capital floor from the same realized-equity basis

invariants: A profitable Pump sleeve may compound independently of Pons and vice versa; no cross-family capital transfer is created.
Open-position unrealized gains never enlarge a new entry target.
Realized profit is eligible for sizing only after native terminal accounting and sleeve reconciliation make it durable.
Realized losses reduce the next target immediately after durable reconciliation.

Available capital, turnover, independent-demand capacity, execution stress, fill-time breadth retention, freshness, generation fencing, concentration, creator/distribution safety, and all hard stops remain binding.
A dynamic target is an upper bound, never a mandate to deploy the full amount.
promotion_requirements: Do not compose into the active Stage E/F/G exact-candidate lineage.
After Stage E/F/G is complete, regenerate this patch against the exact final machinery SHA and the already-prepared strategy layers.
Make realized-equity sizing a single shared deterministic primitive used by all four directional regimes rather than four independent formulas.
Prove restart/replay reconstructs identical realized equity and target size.
Prove unrealized marks and partial nonterminal state cannot increase the sizing basis.
Prove durable terminal profits increase and durable losses decrease the next target.
Prove available-capital and shared-sleeve reservation fences still prevent over-allocation and duplicate Current/Survivor exposure.
Run exact boundary tests for 500 bps target and Pons Survivor 5 bps minimum.
Run execution-capacity, turnover, breadth, accounting, restart, and policy-identity regressions.
Run exact-SHA non-market certification before any PAPER market smoke.
Economic sizing changed, so affected directional profitability cohorts must restart after final promotion.
